messages:
Maria (People Ops): Thanks for joining the all-hands. Quick follow-up thread to capture questions about Q3 hiring, team changes, and the people sprint timeline.

Javier (CEO): High level: budget approved for ~12 net hires. Priorities: infra/runtime, platform, CS integrations to support Dedicated customers.

Priya (Director, Eng): Can we get a team-level split and which are net new vs backfills?

Maria (People Ops): Draft breakdown (exec review): Infra/runtime=5 (4 net,1 backfill); Platform=3 (2 net,1 backfill); CS/Integrations=3 (3 net). +2 buffer for attrition. These are slots to open in the ATS, not offers yet.

Sarah (VP Eng): Note: several infra hires are milestone-gated to Dedicated launch. If launch slips >2w we may re-prioritize some slots to platform/CS.

Eli (Eng Manager): TLs: how will mobility work if internal folks apply? I need coverage for on-call.

Maria (People Ops): Mobility window = 3 weeks after an offer wave. Leads submit mobility form with coverage plan; internal candidates prioritized but approvals consider delivery impact.

ops-bot: Document pinned: "Q3 hiring tracker & mobility rubric" https://redwood.company/s/people/q3-tracker :pushpin:

Sam (Recruiter): JD freeze this Fri. Proposed offer waves: 2026-05-04, 2026-05-18, 2026-06-08. Recruiting will space waves to match mentor capacity.

Zoe (Staff PM): Please add mentor bandwidth guidance and a small FAQ in the tracker so teams can plan ramping.

Maria (People Ops): Agreed. Recommended mentor commitment: 10-15 hrs/week for weeks 1-4, tapering after. I'll add a mentor column and FAQ to the shared sheet and pin it.

Priya (Director, Eng): One ask: mark geo/on-site requirements per req (some Dedicated pairing will need presence).

Maria (People Ops): Will annotate each req with geo flags. If managers need faster approvals or comp exceptions, DM People Ops. I'll keep this thread updated and send a company email when reqs go live. :thumbsup:
